Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform

Initech builds the billing and payments infrastructure that thousands of online merchants rely on every day. We are looking for a senior engineer to join the platform team in Springfield or remotely within the United States.

What you will do
- Design, build and operate distributed services in Go and Kotlin that move money reliably.
- Own the reliability of the ledger service, including on-call rotations, incident reviews and capacity planning.
- Partner with product managers and designers to scope features and write technical design documents.
- Improve developer tooling, continuous integration pipelines and observability across the platform.
- Mentor engineers through code review, pairing and technical talks.

What we look for
- Six or more years of professional software development, ideally on high-volume transactional systems.
- Deep experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including schema design and query tuning.
- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP, containers and Kubernetes.
- A track record of shipping in small, safe increments and measuring the results.
- Clear writing and a collaborative approach to solving ambiguous problems.

Compensation for this role is $170,000 to $210,000 base plus equity and a yearly bonus. Initech offers flexible time off, parental leave and a home office stipend.

Initech is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and welcomes applicants of every background.
